topic: Check Point vulnerability CVE-2026-93616 exposes real risk
headline_marked: [[Critical Check Point vulnerability CVE-2026-93616]] actively exploited, CISA warns
headline: Critical Check Point vulnerability CVE-2026-93616 actively exploited, CISA warns
summary: Rated 9.8 (Critical) CVSS v3, this path traversal flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary scripts on management and logging products. CISA confirms active exploitation.
details: CVE-2026-93616 is a critical path traversal vulnerability in Check Point management and logging products, rated 9.8 (Critical) under CVSS v3. CISA added it to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on September 22, 2026, confirming active exploitation in the wild. Check Point has also acknowledged attacks on "a handful of customers."

The flaw allows an unauthenticated attacker to upload and execute arbitrary scripts by escaping intended directories. Exploitation requires direct reachability to TCP port 19009 on an affected build, with no authentication needed. The reported sequence involves a direct connection followed by a crafted file upload.

Successful exploitation on a management server grants attackers access to the control plane, enabling policy modification, configuration data reading, and leveraging trusted management channels to reach managed devices. On logging and event components, attackers gain access to records vital for detection and investigation, compromising both defensive posture and incident reconstruction.

Affected products include Check Point Security Management Server, Multi-Domain Security Management Server, Log Server, Multi-Domain Log Server, and SmartEvent. Specific vulnerable releases are defined by hotfix take levels, such as R82.10 with Jumbo Hotfix Take 44 or below, and various older versions. Smart-1 Cloud and Check Point Firewall Appliances are reported as unaffected.

Assessing real exposure is complex; it's crucial to differentiate between the total number of Check Point assets and those running affected builds with exposed vulnerable interfaces. Public internet scans showing general Check Point instances do not indicate actual vulnerability, as the critical factor is management interface reachability on TCP port 19009, which requires direct testing.

A final patch covering all affected releases was not available at the time of reporting, and LivePatch Take 28 and Take 29 do not resolve the flaw. Mitigation recommendations include restricting management server access behind a security gateway and limiting TCP port 19009 to trusted IP addresses. Organizations should follow the official Check Point advisory for specific fix statuses and apply vendor updates as they become available.

topic: EcoCart AI calculates real-time carbon footprints for sustainable shopping
headline_marked: [[EcoCart AI calculates real-time carbon footprints]] for online shopping in under 2 seconds
headline: EcoCart AI calculates real-time carbon footprints for online shopping in under 2 seconds
summary: This browser extension grades products from A to F based on sustainability, recommends greener alternatives, and calculates carbon offsets at checkout, all within 2 seconds.
details: EcoCart AI is a new browser extension designed to make online shopping more sustainable. It analyzes product pages in real-time to calculate their environmental impact, delivering an Eco-Score within 2 seconds of a user opening a page.

The extension features an Eco-Scoring System that grades products from A to F based on material sustainability, manufacturer ethics, and shipping distance. It also recommends smart alternatives from greener brands or local sellers if an item has a poor score.

Additionally, EcoCart AI offers a Carbon Offset at Checkout feature. This automatically calculates the exact cost to offset the carbon footprint of a delivery, allowing users to purchase offsets with a single click.

The prototype was built during a 48-hour hackathon using a modern stack. The frontend and extension utilize JavaScript, HTML, TailwindCSS, and the Chrome Extension V3 API, while the backend runs on Node.js with Express hosted on Vercel.

For AI and data extraction, the Gemini Pro API is used to scrape and summarize product descriptions and sustainability reports. MongoDB Atlas caches scored products to reduce external API calls and optimize performance.

Developers overcame challenges like scraping dynamic e-commerce pages by using MutationObservers. They also optimized AI context window usage by preprocessing functions to filter out irrelevant HTML, passing only raw product specs to the LLM.

Future plans for EcoCart AI include expanding support to more retailers beyond Amazon, such as regional grocery and fashion platforms. The team also aims to introduce gamified sustainability features, including user profiles, badges, and carbon savings tracking.
